# Code review

AI agents write most changes in this repo, from a plan in the linked issue. When you review a pull request:

- Use the severity rubric and finding format in `.agents/skills/review-findings/SKILL.md`.
- Check the change against the plan in the linked issue and the PR description.
- Hold it to `AGENTS.md`, `.agents/skills/project-conventions/SKILL.md` and the facts in `.agents/skills/project-memory/`.
- Comment on real problems: bugs, missing tests, security, broken conventions. Leave style to the linter.
